meta.description: Rolls the margin of a cap in under it, every ray bends down towards its tip. Join the caps that share a stipe (flesh and ridges) into one margin_curl and the ridges roll under with the flesh. Gives the margin of the posed cap as points.

cap.description: The rays of a cap, or of several caps on the same stipes

hinge.description: The hinge of the cap node: where the cap sits

amount.description: How far the margin rolls in under the cap. 0 = not at all, 1 = rolled under like a button

reach.description: How much of the cap rolls in, as a share of the way from the margin to the centre
